item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. An intense northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China later on Monday to Tuesday. There will be a few showers and temperatures will fall progressively over the region. It will be rather cool in the morning and at night in the following couple of days. The weather will become fine and dry. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 23/11 (Saturday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at night.
Weather: Sunny periods. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 19 - 23 C
R.H. range: 65 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 24/11 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 23 C
R.H. range: 65 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 25/11 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground. Becoming northeast force 5 at night.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two showers later.
Temp range: 20 - 23 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 26/11 (Tuesday)
